title: 36 Hours in Ottawa
abstract: Ottawa gears up for its 150th birthday bash this year, with exhibits, galleries and a thriving food scene.

title: 36 Hours in Charleston, S.C.
abstract: The belle of South Carolina, with its cobblestone streets and complex history, has become a cultural hotbed and gastro-magnet.

title: 36 Hours in Galveston, Tex.
abstract: Though it’s now known mostly as a frothy beach resort, this port city, population 49,000, has more character than most flip-flop playgrounds.

title: 36 Hours in Santiago, Chile
abstract: The Chilean capital offers a dynamic cultural landscape, with world-class chefs, design-forward shops and energy to spare.
